review_note: The SD1.5-IP2P grid shows severe painterly smearing and is not usable as a film translation deliverable. These values are preserved only to document the least-bad cells in the failed grid, not as recommended defaults.

ektar_100.reason: Least artifacted among saturated Ektar candidates; stronger guidance becomes noisy.

hp5.reason: Best balance of black-and-white shift and content preservation.

portra_400.reason: Slightly stronger film shift than 1.0/5.0 without the 7.5-10.0 artifact jump.

portra_800.reason: Moderate tonal change with acceptable structure; higher guidance introduces sky/water damage.

tri_x_400.reason: Most usable monochrome candidate before high-guidance structure loss.

velvia_50.reason: Least artifacted candidate; Velvia saturation prompt overdrives texture at higher guidance.

vision3_250d.reason: Preserves scene best; stronger guidance adds painterly/noisy texture.

vision3_500t.reason: Most stable candidate; 7.5 and 10.0 increase visible artifacts.
